exposure: Frozen embryo transfer (FET) with artificial cycle (AC-FET)
Frozen embryo transfer (FET) with natural/modified natural/stimulated cycle (CL-FET)
cohort: 1168 singleton pregnancies and live births following FET
finding: The risk of HDP and several other maternal complications, including placental retention, appears to be increased after AC-FET compared with CL-FET.
